argus-config.description: Allows values for the argus-config Helm chart

global.description: Global configuration for the stack - this serves as the default configuration for all services/jobs/cronjobs

annotations.description: Global annotations to add to all resources

argoBuildEnv.description: Argo built-in environment parameters (provided by Argus API)

appName.description: Set by Argus API to ARGOCD_APP_NAME (this is the ArgoCD app name, not the Argus app name)

appNamespace.description: Set by Argus API to ARGOCD_APP_NAMESPACE

appRevision.description: Set by Argus API to ARGOCD_APP_REVISION

appRevisionShort.description: Set by Argus API to ARGOCD_APP_REVISION_SHORT

appRevisionShort8.description: Set by Argus API to ARGOCD_APP_REVISION_SHORT_8

appSourcePath.description: Set by Argus API to ARGOCD_APP_SOURCE_PATH

appSourceRepoUrl.description: Set by Argus API to ARGOCD_APP_SOURCE_REPO_URL

appSourceTargetRevision.description: Set by Argus API to ARGOCD_APP_SOURCE_REPO_URL

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command in the primary container

appName.description: Set by Argus API to Argus app name

envName.description: Set by Argus API to Argus environment name

repoName.description: Set by Argus API to Argus repository name

repoOwner.description: Set by Argus API to Argus repository owner

stackName.description: Set by Argus API to Argus stack name

maxUnavailable.description: Pods that may be unavailable during voluntary disruption (integer or percentage string such as "25%"), applied to the service PodDisruptionBudget. Governs eviction-based disruption (Karpenter consolidation, drift, node drain), NOT Deployment rollouts. Ignored when pdb.minAvailable is set.

command.description: Command to run in the primary container

deploymentKind.description: Specifies the Kubernetes Kind for the main application workload controller (Deployment or Rollout).

envFrom.description: Environment variables from configmaps or secrets

fullnameOverride.description: Name to prefix the K8s resources with, replaces the stack name prefix

annotations.description: Annotations to add to HTTPRoute resources

backendTLS.description: TLS to the upstream Service via a BackendTLSPolicy (gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1)

caCertificateRefs.description: ConfigMap refs holding the CA bundle for self-signed/internal upstreams

hostname.description: SNI/validation hostname presented by the upstream (required when enabled)

wellKnownCACertificates.description: Use the System trust store, or set "" and use caCertificateRefs for a private CA

dnsOwner.description: Which routing mode external-dns publishes when ingress and gateway are both enabled (coexistence). The non-owning side gets the external-dns exclude annotation. Flip to gateway to move the DNS record from the nginx NLB to the Envoy gateway NLB with both paths still serving. Setting this at the service level marks coexistence intent (the gateway is not auto-disabled by an explicitly enabled ingress) and never enables routing by itself. Gateway hosts the ingress does not serve keep publishing during coexistence

enabled.description: Enable Gateway API HTTPRoute (alternative to Ingress)

gatewayName.description: Name of the Gateway resource to attach to

hostRewrite.description: Rewrite the Host header sent upstream via an HTTPRoute URLRewrite filter, empty disables it

hsts.description: Strict-Transport-Security header always emitted on gateway HTTPRoutes (not disableable by design), matching the fleet-wide HSTS that nginx-ingress sets via its controller ConfigMap

value.description: Header value, overridden by a Strict-Transport-Security entry in responseHeaders.set

rateLimit.description: Local rate limit via a BackendTrafficPolicy (Envoy local token bucket, no burst concept)

unit.description: Rate limit unit (Second, Minute, Hour, Day)

redirect.description: Whole-route redirect via an HTTPRoute RequestRedirect filter, replaces backend routing for the host

hostname.description: Target hostname, empty keeps the request host

path.description: Replacement full path via ReplaceFullPath, empty keeps the path

rules.description: List of additional HTTPRoute rules with custom hosts. Each entry takes host, optional paths, and an optional vanity block (enabled, hostname, clusterIssuer) that renders a per-host ListenerSet so the extra host can be a vanity domain, mirroring gateway.vanity

sectionName.description: Optional section name (listener name) on the Gateway

securityPolicy.description: Name of a global.securityPolicies entry to attach to this service, or oidc-protected-default for zero-config OIDC. Empty or none means no policy is attached and the route stays public. Services naming the same policy on the same hostname share one SecurityPolicy and therefore one OIDC session

sessionAffinity.description: Cookie-based sticky sessions via a BackendTrafficPolicy. Off by default (the ingress cookie-affinity default is not carried to the gateway)

timeouts.description: HTTPRoute timeouts. request maps to nginx proxy-read and send-timeout. connect (optional) renders a BackendTrafficPolicy

backendRequest.description: Per-try backend request timeout (HTTPRoute rules[].timeouts.backendRequest). Must be <= request

connect.description: Optional upstream TCP connect timeout (renders BackendTrafficPolicy timeout.tcp.connectTimeout), empty uses the Envoy default

request.description: Overall request timeout (HTTPRoute rules[].timeouts.request). Set "0s" to disable, e.g. for streaming or websockets

tlsPassthrough.description: TLS passthrough via a TLSRoute (the Gateway does not terminate TLS). Mutually exclusive with the L7 gateway features, and requires a Passthrough listener on the shared Gateway

enabled.description: Render a TLSRoute instead of an HTTPRoute and skip TLS termination for this service

sectionName.description: Optional Passthrough listener name to pin to. Empty attaches by hostname plus TLS protocol, which is the usual case

vanity.description: Self-serve public/vanity-domain TLS via a tenant-owned Gateway API ListenerSet (requires Envoy Gateway >= v1.8 and cert-manager >= v1.20)

clusterIssuer.description: cert-manager ClusterIssuer used by the gateway-shim to issue the listener certificate

enabled.description: Render a ListenerSet attaching an HTTPS listener for this service's vanity domain to the shared Gateway

hostname.description: Listener SNI hostname (defaults to gateway.host). A wildcard such as *.parent requires a dns01-capable issuer because http01 cannot issue wildcard certs

enabled.description: Enable Grafana dashboard (globally, can be overridden per service)

extraPanels.description: Extra panels to add to the Grafana dashboard

instanceSelector.description: Instance selector for the Grafana dashboard

refresh.description: Dashboard auto-refresh interval, empty string disables auto-refresh (global-only, a per-service setting has no effect)

resyncPeriod.description: How often the grafana-operator re-applies drift for the stack dashboard and folders, minutes or hours only (global-only, a per-service setting has no effect)

oidcProtected.description: Enable OIDC protection (route to oauth2-proxy when using Ingress)

kedaAutoscaling.description: KEDA autoscaling configuration (creates a ScaledObject instead of HPA)

cooldownPeriod.description: Period in seconds to wait after the last trigger fires before scaling back to minReplicas

pollingInterval.description: Interval in seconds to check each trigger

triggers.description: List of KEDA triggers (e.g. prometheus, cpu, memory, cron)

failureThreshold.description: Number of failures before the probe is considered failed

httpGet.description: HTTP probe configuration (exec & tcpSocket are also available)

initialDelaySeconds.description: Number of seconds after the container has started before the probe is first initiated

periodSeconds.description: How often to perform the probe

successThreshold.description: Number of successes before the probe is considered successful

nameOverride.description: Name to prefix the K8s resources with, combined with the stack name prefix

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the OIDC proxy

cookieRefresh.description: Refresh tokens and cookies after this period

extraArgs.description: Extra arguments to pass to the OIDC proxy

volumeMounts.description: Volume mounts for the OIDC proxy

pdb.description: PodDisruptionBudget configuration. Exactly one PDB is always created per service, because a pod matched by more than one PDB can never be evicted.

minAvailable.description: Pods that must remain available during voluntary disruption (integer or percentage string such as "50%"). Mutually exclusive with autoscaling.maxUnavailable and takes precedence over it. Set to 1 to make a single-replica service block eviction entirely, which stops Karpenter consolidation from taking its only pod. Requires a NodePool terminationGracePeriod so drift and expiration drains stay bounded. Leave empty to use autoscaling.maxUnavailable.

apiGroup.description: API version of the data source

kind.description: Kind of the data source [VolumeSnapshot, PersistentVolumeClaim]

podLabels.description: Global labels to add to all pods

progressDeadlineSeconds.description: the number of seconds the Deployment controller waits before indicating (in the Deployment status) that the Deployment progress has stalled

failureThreshold.description: Number of failures before the probe is considered failed

httpGet.description: HTTP probe configuration (exec & tcpSocket are also available)

initialDelaySeconds.description: Number of seconds after the container has started before the probe is first initiated

periodSeconds.description: How often to perform the probe

successThreshold.description: Number of successes before the probe is considered successful

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the primary container

accessModes.description: Access modes for the S3 storage

securityPolicies.description: Named SecurityPolicy definitions. Each entry carries oidc (issuer, clientSecretName, scopes, skipAuth, apiRoutes, denyRedirect, cookie settings), basicAuth, jwt, cors, ipAllowList and annotations. Services attach one by name with gateway.securityPolicy. A policy is realized once per hostname, so services naming the same policy on the same host share one SecurityPolicy and therefore one OIDC session. The oidc-protected-default entry is built in and needs no declaration

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account

automount.description: Specifies whether to automatically mount a ServiceAccount's API credentials

create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created

name.description: Name of the service account to use (if not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template)

failureThreshold.description: Number of failures before the probe is considered failed

initialDelaySeconds.description: Number of seconds after the container has started before the probe is first initiated

periodSeconds.description: How often to perform the probe

successThreshold.description: Number of successes before the probe is considered successful

strategy.description: Deployment update strategy. Empty writes no strategy field, so Kubernetes applies its default of RollingUpdate with maxSurge and maxUnavailable at 25%. Governs Deployment rollouts only, NOT eviction-based disruption (Karpenter consolidation and drift honor the PodDisruptionBudget instead, see pdb.minAvailable and autoscaling.maxUnavailable). Ignored when deploymentKind is Rollout, which uses rollout.strategy.

maxSurge.description: Pods that may be created above the desired count during a rollout, as an integer or percentage string. Set to 0 to roll strictly in place so the rollout never waits on new nodes and cannot stall on capacity. Requires a non-zero maxUnavailable.

maxUnavailable.description: Pods that may be unavailable during a rollout, as an integer or percentage string.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for the pod

volumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts on the output Deployment definition

volumes.description: Additional volumes on the output Deployment definition

strategy.description: Specifies the rollout strategy for the application.

activeService.description: Name of the service that the rollout modifies as the active service.

autoPromotionEnabled.description: indicates if the rollout should automatically promote the new ReplicaSet to the active service or enter a paused state.

prePromotionAnalysis.description: configuration to run analysis before a selector switch

previewService.description: Name of the service that the rollout modifies as the preview service.

rolloutAnalysis.description: defines a template that is used to create a analysisRun

analysisRunMetadata.description: extra labels to add to the AnalysisRun

annotations.description: additional annotations to add to the AnalysisRun

labels.description: additional labels to add to the AnalysisRun

args.description: the arguments that will be added to the AnalysisRuns

templates.description: reference to a list of analysis templates to combine for an AnalysisRun

clusterScope.description: Whether to look for the templateName at cluster scope or namespace scope.

templateName.description: name of the AnalysisTemplate to use for the rollout analysis
